svg.title: Three greedy runs repeat each other, three sampled runs do not
svg.desc: A grid of the 30 subset tasks for Qwen3 4B on the Mac. The plain loop and the deep agent each ran three times at temperature 0 and seed 42, and every run gave the same outcome on every task, with the same tokens and tool calls: 23 and 13 of 30. The plain loop at temperature 0.7 with seeds 1, 2 and 3 passed 24, 23, 23 of 30, and 5 tasks changed outcome between seeds: chain07, chain13, chain16, sql16, files07.
svg.text: amber marks: the 5 tasks whose outcome changed between seeds
